ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives the piecewise graph of the function f(x). Within the interval (-3,6), on the left there is a dashed vertical line, located between x=-2 and x=-1, and the curve behaves as a vertical asymptote there. The graph has a solid point at x=0, and the left and right graphs connect to the same point; at x=2 there is also a solid point, and the line segment connects with the curve on the right. On the right-side curve there is an open circle at x=3; at x=4, the curve has an open circle, and there is another solid point, and from this solid point a line segment begins and extends to x=6. Reasoning: Only count x values within the open interval (-3,6). The dashed vertical asymptote gives 1 discontinuity point. At x=0 and x=2, the graph is connected with solid points and the left and right behavior match, so they are not counted as discontinuities. At x=3 there is an open circle and there is no solid point at the same x value, so the function is discontinuous, count 1. At x=4, the left-side curve approaches the y value of the open circle, while the function value and the right-side line segment begin from another solid point, so the left and right/function values do not match, count 1. The endpoints x=-3 and x=6 are not within the open interval, so they are not counted. Therefore there are 3 discontinuity points in total.

method.method_draft: Scan the graph from left to right only for x-values inside the open interval (-3, 6). From the image, note a dashed vertical line/asymptote between x=-2 and x=-1, giving one discontinuity. Continue through the graph: the pieces meet at x=0 and x=2 with filled points and matching behavior, so do not count them. At x=3 there is an open circle on the curve with no filled point at that same x-value, so count a removable discontinuity. At x=4 the curve has an open circle at y=2 while a filled point and line segment begin at y=3, so the left-hand and actual/right-hand values do not match; count another discontinuity. The endpoints x=-3 and x=6 are excluded by the text. Total: 3 discontinuities.
